property.name: firstnameLabel
property.label: First Name Label
property.description: The label for the field where a user enters a first name.

property.name: lastnameLabel
property.label: Last Name Label
property.description: The label for the field where a user enters a last name.

property.name: emailLabel
property.label: Email Label
property.description: The label for the field where a user enters a valid email address.

property.name: createPasswordLabel
property.label: Create Password Label
property.description: The label for the field where a user requests a new password.

property.name: confirmPasswordLabel
property.label: Confirm Password Label
property.description: The label for the field where users enter a new password, for the second time, to verify their identity.

property.name: submitButtonLabel
property.label: Submit Button Label
property.description: The label for the button that a user clicks to request a new account.

property.name: cancelLinkLabel
property.label: Cancel Link Label
property.description: The label for the link that the user clicks to return to the login page.

property.name: includePasswordField
property.label: Include Password Field?
property.description: Require the user to provide a password when registering.

property.name: startUrl
property.label: Start URL
property.description: The page users see after registering successfully.

property.name: regConfirmUrl
property.label: Registration Confirmation URL
property.description: The page users see after successfully registering without a password.

property.name: rawInternationalizationData
property.label: Country Data
property.description: Internationalization data for countries, typically provided by the I18n.Countries data provider.

property.name: consentData
property.label: Marketing Consent Data
property.description: Marketing consent subscription data, typically provided by the Marketing.Subscriptions data provider.
